title: Added the [`beforePasteParse`](https://handsontable.com/docs/basic-clipboard/#clean-up-pasted-content-before-it-is-parsed) hook to the `CopyPaste` plugin. It fires before the clipboard content is sanitized and parsed, and passes a writable copy of the clipboard and the native `ClipboardEvent` to the callback, so you can clean pasted data without disabling the plugin.
